what: While hovered, the text (or element) flickers quickly every .2s with opacity 1 → .3 → 1 — endlessly, like a trembling fluorescent light. It stops immediately on release. With look: slow the cycle is 1s

options.[data-fx-part=blink]: (If present) Only this child blinks — just the text, button background stays as is

from.where: shared.css all menus·lists·buttons — group-hover:animate-pulse, the original tailwind animate-pulse shortened to .2s
